subject: Confirmation of Flight Reservation
body: Dear Ms. Johnson, We are pleased to confirm your flight reservation for your upcoming trip from New York to London on July 15th. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123 Departure: 10:00 AM Arrival: 3:00 PM We look forward to welcoming you on board. If you have any questions or require further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us. Thank you for choosing our airline. Safe travels! Best regards, The Airline Team
